name: inspire
label: INSPIRE (EU Spatial)
description: EU spatial data infrastructure directive — mandatory for EU government geospatial applications

table_notes.inspire_administrative_unit: Hierarchical administrative boundary units (country/region/municipality) with self-referencing parent link and MULTIPOLYGON geometry per INSPIRE Annex I theme AU.
table_notes.inspire_address: Georeferenced postal addresses per INSPIRE Annex I theme AD, including thoroughfare, locator designator, postcode, and lifecycle status.
table_notes.inspire_building: Above-ground building footprints per INSPIRE Annex III theme BU, with use classification, floor count, height, and linked address.
table_notes.inspire_protected_site: Designated protected areas (Natura 2000, national parks, Ramsar sites) per INSPIRE Annex I theme PS, with scheme and area in hectares.
table_notes.inspire_transport_network: Linear transport network elements (road, rail, waterway, air) per INSPIRE Annex I theme TN, stored as LINESTRING geometry.

inspire_administrative_unit.name: id
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Surrogate UUID primary key for the administrative unit record

inspire_administrative_unit.name: local_id
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Persistent local identifier assigned by the data provider (INSPIRE thematic identifier)

inspire_administrative_unit.name: national_code
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Official national code for this unit (e.g. NUTS code, LAU code, or national registry ID)

inspire_administrative_unit.name: country_code
inspire_administrative_unit.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code identifying the member state this unit belongs to

inspire_administrative_unit.name: upper_level_unit
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Self-reference to the parent administrative unit one level up in the hierarchy

inspire_administrative_unit.name: geometry
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Official boundary polygon(s) in WGS84; use MULTIPOLYGON to support non-contiguous territories

inspire_administrative_unit.name: validity_begin
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Date from which this unit's definition (boundary, code) is legally valid

inspire_administrative_unit.name: validity_end
inspire_administrative_unit.description: Date on which this unit ceased to be valid; NULL means currently active

inspire_address.name: id
inspire_address.description: Surrogate UUID primary key for the address record

inspire_address.name: local_id
inspire_address.description: Persistent local identifier assigned by the national address registry

inspire_address.name: locator_designator
inspire_address.description: House number or other locator (e.g. '42', '42A', 'Unit 7') within the thoroughfare

inspire_address.name: thoroughfare_name
inspire_address.description: Name of the road, street, or route where the address is located

inspire_address.name: postcode
inspire_address.description: Postal code for mail delivery routing (format varies by country)

inspire_address.name: post_name
inspire_address.description: Name of the postal locality or town associated with the postcode

inspire_address.name: admin_unit_id
inspire_address.description: Reference to the administrative unit (inspire_administrative_unit) in which this address falls

inspire_address.name: country_code
inspire_address.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; redundant with admin_unit but required by INSPIRE AD schema

inspire_address.name: geo_position
inspire_address.description: Georeferenced position of the address in WGS84 (doorway, parcel centroid, or rooftop)

inspire_address.name: status
inspire_address.description: Lifecycle status per INSPIRE AD codelist: current, proposed, retired, etc.

inspire_address.name: validity_begin
inspire_address.description: Date from which this address record is officially valid

inspire_building.name: id
inspire_building.description: Surrogate UUID primary key for the building record

inspire_building.name: local_id
inspire_building.description: Persistent local identifier from the national building registry

inspire_building.name: current_use
inspire_building.description: Primary use classification per INSPIRE BU codelist (e.g. residential, agriculture, industrial)

inspire_building.name: number_of_floors
inspire_building.description: Total count of above-ground floors (storeys) in the building

inspire_building.name: number_of_dwellings
inspire_building.description: Count of separate residential dwelling units within the building

inspire_building.name: date_of_construction
inspire_building.description: Date the building construction was completed or officially registered

inspire_building.name: geometry_2d
inspire_building.description: 2D footprint polygon of the building outline at ground level in WGS84

inspire_building.name: height_above_ground
inspire_building.description: Building height in metres measured from ground level to rooftop

inspire_building.name: address_id
inspire_building.description: Reference to the primary postal address (inspire_address) for this building

inspire_protected_site.name: id
inspire_protected_site.description: Surrogate UUID primary key for the protected site record

inspire_protected_site.name: local_id
inspire_protected_site.description: Persistent local identifier from the originating designation authority

inspire_protected_site.name: site_name
inspire_protected_site.description: Official name of the protected area as designated by the relevant authority

inspire_protected_site.name: designation_scheme
inspire_protected_site.description: Name of the legal protection scheme (e.g. Natura2000, Ramsar, UNESCO-MaB, national park)

inspire_protected_site.name: designation_code
inspire_protected_site.description: Code within the scheme's codelist (e.g. Natura2000 site code SAC/SPA, Ramsar site number)

inspire_protected_site.name: site_area_ha
inspire_protected_site.description: Total protected area in hectares as recorded in the official designation document

inspire_protected_site.name: geometry
inspire_protected_site.description: Boundary of the protected site in WGS84; MULTIPOLYGON supports fragmented or marine zones

inspire_transport_network.name: id
inspire_transport_network.description: Surrogate UUID primary key for the transport network element

inspire_transport_network.name: local_id
inspire_transport_network.description: Persistent local identifier from the national transport data authority

inspire_transport_network.name: transport_type
inspire_transport_network.description: Transport medium per INSPIRE TN codelist: road, rail, water, air, cable

inspire_transport_network.name: name
inspire_transport_network.description: Official name of the road, railway line, waterway, or air route segment

inspire_transport_network.name: geometry
inspire_transport_network.description: Centre-line geometry of the network link in WGS84 for routing and display

inspire_transport_network.name: begin_lifetime
inspire_transport_network.description: Date from which this network element exists in the real world (opening date)

short_description: EU spatial data infrastructure directive — mandatory for EU government geospatial applications
long_description: INSPIRE (Infrastructure for Spatial Information in the European Community) is the EU directive requiring public authorities to publish geospatial data in standardized formats. The schema covers the most commonly implemented themes: administrative units (country/region/municipality boundaries), addresses, buildings, and transport networks.
when_to_use: Use for any EU government GIS application, smart city platform, or spatial data infrastructure. EU Directive 2007/2/EC mandates INSPIRE compliance for all public sector bodies. Required for environmental impact assessments, urban planning permits, and emergency response systems in EU countries.
